# ArmSoft SME Trade Public API — Full Reference for LLMs

> This file is intended for AI language models and crawlers.
> It contains the full inline content of this documentation repository.
> Structured index: ./llms.txt

---

## Overview

The ArmSoft SME Trade Public API is a RESTful API for managing trade operations in the ArmSoft SME Trade ERP system. It is built on ASP.NET Core 10 / C# 13 and supports Armenian, English, and Russian locales.

- **Base URL:** `https://api.armsoft.am/trade/v1`
- **Swagger UI:** `https://api.armsoft.am/trade/swagger/index.html`
- **OpenAPI spec:** `./swagger.json` (full), `./openapi/openapi.yaml` (curated)
- **Authentication:** API Key in `apiKey` request header
- **Localization:** `Accept-Language` header (`hy-AM`, `en-US`, `ru-RU`)

---

## Authentication

All requests require an `apiKey` header:

```http
apiKey: your-api-key-here
Accept-Language: en-US
```

### API Key Types

**Full Access** — Complete CRUD on all resources. For internal/trusted integrations.

**Limited Access (Online Store)** — Read-only product catalog, create/read/update/delete sale documents. For e-commerce, mobile apps, POS systems.

### Error Responses

| Status | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| 401 (no body) | API key missing |
| 401 `{ "message": "Public API access is not available for this API Key" }` | Invalid key |
| 401 `{ "message": "Access denied. This API Key has limited access and cannot perform this operation." }` | Insufficient permissions |

---

## Error Response Format

All errors return:

```json
{
  "message": "Human-readable description (localized)",
  "fieldName": "field-that-caused-error",
  "errorCode": "MACHINE_READABLE_CODE"
}
```

`fieldName` and `errorCode` are optional.

---

## Pagination

List endpoints support optional pagination via `pageSize` in the request body.

- `pageSize: 0` (default) — returns all rows
- `pageSize: N` — minimum effective value is 5000

Paginated responses include:
- `id` (UUID) — pagination context identifier
- `hasMore` (boolean) — whether more pages exist

To fetch the next page, POST to `/list/nextpage`:

```json
{ "id": "uuid-from-previous-response", "close": false }
```

To stop paginating early:

```json
{ "id": "uuid-from-previous-response", "close": true }
```

---

## HTTP Status Codes

| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| 200 | OK — successful GET, PUT, DELETE |
| 201 | Created — resource created (POST) |
| 400 | Bad Request — validation error |
| 401 | Unauthorized — missing/invalid API key |
| 403 | Forbidden — key valid but action not allowed |
| 404 | Not Found — resource does not exist |
| 405 | Method Not Allowed |
| 409 | Conflict — duplicate code or resource in use |
| 429 | Too Many Requests — rate limit exceeded |
| 500 | Internal Server Error |
| 503 | Service Unavailable |

---

## Products Endpoints

### List Products
`POST /trade/v1/directories/products/list`

Request body (all fields optional except `showMode`):
```json
{
  "showMode": "3",
  "pageSize": 0
}
```

Response:
```json
{
  "id": "uuid",
  "hasMore": false,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 100001,
      "code": "PROD001",
      "name": "Product Name",
      "baseUnitMeasure": "PCS",
      "vat": true,
      "showInPriceLists": true
    }
  ]
}
```

### List Products — Next Page
`POST /trade/v1/directories/products/list/nextpage`

### Get Product by Code
`GET /trade/v1/directories/products/{code}`

Response:
```json
{
  "id": 12345,
  "code": "PROD001",
  "name": "Sample Product",
  "baseUnitMeasure": "PCS",
  "vat": true,
  "showInPriceLists": true
}
```

### Create Product
`POST /trade/v1/directories/products`

### Update Product
`PUT /trade/v1/directories/products/{code}`

### Delete Product
`DELETE /trade/v1/directories/products/{code}`

---

## Product Measure Units Endpoints

### List Measure Units
`POST /trade/v1/directories/products/measureunits/list`

### List Measure Units — Next Page
`POST /trade/v1/directories/products/measureunits/list/nextpage`

### Get Measure Unit
`GET /trade/v1/directories/products/{productCode}/measureunits/{unitCode}`

### Create Measure Unit
`POST /trade/v1/directories/products/measureunits`

### Update Measure Unit
`PUT /trade/v1/directories/products/{productCode}/measureunits/{unitCode}`

### Delete Measure Unit
`DELETE /trade/v1/directories/products/{productCode}/measureunits/{unitCode}`

---

## Localization

| Header Value | Language |
|---|---|
| `hy-AM` | Armenian (default) |
| `en-US` | English |
| `ru-RU` | Russian |

Localization affects error messages, validation messages, and localized display fields (e.g. `typeName`, `groupName`). Code and identifier fields are locale-independent.

---

## C# Example

```csharp
var client = new HttpClient { BaseAddress = new Uri("https://api.armsoft.am/trade/v1") };
client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("apiKey", "your-api-key-here");
client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Accept-Language", "en-US");

var response = await client.GetAsync("directories/products/PROD001");
```

## About

ArmSoft (Armenian Software) is a leading ERP provider for businesses in Armenia. The Trade system targets small and medium enterprises for trade operations management.

- Website: https://armsoft.am
- Support: support@armsoft.am
